model: KAJPLATS LED bulb E27 1055 lm, colour and white spectrum (706.085.75)
name: IKEA KAJPLATS E27 colour bulb (EU)

radios.note: IKEA describes it as Matter over Thread. Bluetooth comes only from the CSA certification listing (Thread and Bluetooth transports); IKEA's page doesn't mention it, and it is presumably for Matter commissioning.

matter.note: CSA certificate CSA25G1ZMAT49049-24 (certified 2025-12-16, Matter 1.4, Thread and Bluetooth). IKEA says KAJPLATS replaced TRÅDFRI in January 2026, mainly for security and Matter compatibility.

apple_home.note: IKEA names Apple among compatible systems; works via Matter over Thread and needs a Thread border router.

google_home.note: IKEA names Google among compatible systems; works via Matter over Thread and needs a Thread border router.

alexa.note: IKEA names Amazon among compatible systems; works via Matter over Thread and needs an Echo that is a Thread border router.

smartthings.note: IKEA names Samsung among compatible systems; works via Matter over Thread and needs a SmartThings hub that is a Thread border router.

home_assistant.note: Via the official Matter integration with a Thread border router.

hubRequired.note: IKEA says phone control needs a Thread border router, e.g. its DIRIGERA hub. A HomePod, Nest Hub or Thread-capable Echo also works as a border router.

localControl.note: Matter over Thread runs on the local network without a cloud service.

colorType.note: Colour and white spectrum: full colour plus adjustable white.

summary: Bring a Thread border router and the IKEA KAJPLATS E27 colour bulb works with Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant over Matter. Without one, not even your phone can control it. IKEA's DIRIGERA hub does the job, as does a HomePod, Nest Hub or Thread-capable Echo. The bulb (706.085.75) puts out 1055 lumens with full colour plus adjustable white, and it's Matter-certified (Matter 1.4). IKEA says KAJPLATS replaced TRÅDFRI in January 2026.
caveats: Needs a Thread border router (IKEA DIRIGERA, HomePod, Nest Hub or a Thread-capable Echo) even for phone control.
